task:
Implement issue #579 on the existing target branch, based on exact starting head 9733a419c9675387d71306aa7754bd95c0aa2a53. This is a separate platform branch that will later merge into draft integration PR #578. Read CLAUDE.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/development/v3-application-stack-decision.md, docs/development/pull-request-acceptance-policy.md, issue #579, and the current React implementation/tests as behavioural evidence before changing code. Do not merge, deploy, access production, mutate a live database, handle secrets, activate OAuth, implement Babylon, or broaden Stage 27. Keep Cypress as the only active browser framework; Playwright must not return.

Scope this tranche to `apps/web`, framework-neutral modules deliberately relocated/reused for the platform, focused repository contracts/tests, and only narrowly necessary workflow/OpenAPI docs. Avoid touching the Cypress Review Lab remediation files on the integration branch unless strictly necessary, so the branches merge cleanly.

A. Canonical lossless identifier policy
- Define one branded/domain `Id64` representation owned by the Svelte application. Prefer a canonical decimal string at route/store/component boundaries; bigint may be used internally, but no canonical identifier may pass through JavaScript `number`.
- Add strict parse/format/compare helpers accepting decimal string/bigint and rejecting signs, fractions, exponent notation, whitespace, negatives, overflow beyond unsigned 64-bit, unsafe numbers, NaN/Infinity, and lossy coercion. Preserve 0 and values through 18446744073709551615.
- Detect/normalise id64-bearing response fields before ordinary JSON parsing loses precision. Use the existing `json-with-bigint` approach or an equally reviewed lossless parser, then recursively/project explicitly to canonical decimal strings. Do not implement brittle regex rewriting of arbitrary JSON.
- Ensure route params, selected-system state, API path/query/body arguments, DOM/test IDs, storage, exports and SSE events use canonical Id64. Add tests with values immediately above 2^53 and at uint64 max. Add a repository guard against `Number(...)`, `parseInt`, unary plus or number-typed canonical id64 in new application code.

B. Complete handwritten application-facing API facade over Hey API
- Keep generation from the authoritative running FastAPI `/openapi.json` and deterministic snapshot mechanism. Generated files remain generated; application components must not import generated SDK functions directly outside the facade/adapter layer.
- Configure same-origin requests with `credentials: 'include'`; do not invent a production URL or expose secrets as build inputs.
- Implement structured `ApiError` with status, canonical request path, parsed/sanitised body, useful message and cause. Preserve non-JSON and empty error responses.
- Inject `X-Admin-Token` only in browser context, only from `sessionStorage['ed_admin_token']`, only for the bounded owner/admin/operator endpoint classes that currently require it. Do not send it to public/auth/static routes. Provide an explicit endpoint policy and tests.
- Preserve current endpoint compatibility behaviours after verifying them in `frontend/src/lib/api/*`: system envelope `record ?? system` unwrapping, optimiser/default request merge, request header/content semantics, same-origin `/api` de-duplication and any other behaviour proven load-bearing.
- Keep SSE/EventSource as an explicit separate client contract with credentials/reconnect/fallback assumptions documented and unit-testable; do not force it through ordinary generated query functions in this tranche.
- Provide query-key factories and one root TanStack Svelte Query client matching accepted retry/stale/gc defaults.

C. Exact persisted-state compatibility layer
- Create one SSR-safe browser persistence service with versioned codecs, validation, migrations, corruption handling, cross-tab subscription and deterministic fixtures. Do not scatter raw localStorage/sessionStorage calls through components.
- Inventory and reproduce exact current envelopes/legacy shapes from source and tests for localStorage keys: `ed_pinned` (including bare-array legacy adapter), `ed_compare_v2`, `ed_sync_key`, `ed_selected_route`, `ed_my_work_v1`, `ed_colony_projects_v1`, `ed_expansion_plans_v1`, `ed_fc_v2`, `ed_profile_sync_key`, `ed_profile_sync_last`, `ed-finder:selected-system-context`, plus the exact density/preference key discovered from current source. Session keys: `ed_admin_token`, `ed_operator_selected_source_run`.
- Preserve valid unknown fields where the existing migration/merge contract does; never silently overwrite or erase a newer unknown envelope. Corrupt entries should fail safely, retain recoverable user data where possible, and expose a diagnosable state rather than crashing app boot.
- Preserve storage-event synchronisation for compare, FC/profile sync and any other currently cross-tab state. Test hydration from exact legacy fixtures copied from current tests, round trips, corrupt JSON, wrong types, unknown versions, SSR/no-window, and cross-tab updates.
- Build typed Svelte stores/context services for selected system, sync key, pins, compare, FC route, My Work metadata, colony projects, expansion plans, profile-sync metadata, density, admin token and operator handoff. This tranche may expose store APIs and diagnostic shell surfaces but must not yet port the full feature UIs.

D. SvelteKit shell, route ownership and legacy-link compatibility
- Replace the placeholder journey route with an explicit application route skeleton covering current accepted route semantics: Finder/index, Explore/map placeholder, Inspect/System page and overlay, My Work with watchlist/pinned/colony aliases, compare, search tuning, FC, colony planner nested route state, Review/export, Admin, Operator, plus honest 404 handling. Placeholders must clearly say not ported; do not claim feature parity.
- FastAPI continues to own `/api/*`, exact `/openapi.json` and numeric `/s/{id64}`. Add route/proxy/build contracts ensuring no Svelte route or SPA fallback steals them and no broad backend catch-all steals Svelte routes.
- Implement a client-only, idempotent legacy hash compatibility shim based on the exact current parser semantics. Map at minimum empty/`#finder`, `#system/{id64}`, `#{host}/system/{id64}`, `#my-work`, `#watchlist`, `#pinned`, `#colony`, `#compare`, `#map`, `#search-tuning`, `#fc`, `#colony-planner` and nested `/system/{id}/project/{pid}/mode/{mode}/detail/{did}`, `#admin`, `#operator`. Preserve query/hash data deliberately, reject unsafe/invalid id64, avoid redirect loops, and use replace-state navigation.
- Preserve the semantic that System Detail can overlay any host workspace and closing it restores that host; also provide a cold `/system/[id64]` page using the same future content seam. Implement accessible focus return, Escape handling, scroll lock contract and URL/store ownership even if body content remains a placeholder.
- Add `+error.svelte` or Svelte 5 boundary behaviour, skip link, accessible primary navigation, account/auth status region, selected-system context chip, footer attribution and current `data-testid` compatibility needed by Cypress. No service worker/PWA.

E. Auth/session/owner platform context
- Implement a client-side auth store over the API facade for session bootstrap, login redirect, logout, owner claim and derived owner state. Preserve cookie-session semantics and avoid moving calls into SSR without explicit cookie forwarding.
- Implement an accessible owner gate for Admin/Operator route content, with signed-out, signed-in non-owner and owner states. Keep actual admin/operator feature content as placeholders in this tranche.
- Keep admin token session-only, never log/render/persist it to local storage, and clear it under the same conditions as current behaviour.

F. Testing and contracts
- Port/reuse pure route/storage/API/identifier unit tests into Vitest without React. Add Testing Library Svelte tests for shell, overlay lifecycle, owner gate and error states.
- Extend `apps/web` Cypress foundation coverage only for this platform: cold/warm legacy hash redirects, backend-owned route boundaries, overlay Escape/focus restoration, storage hydration, signed-out/non-owner/owner gate, cookie credentials and a lossless oversized id64 path. Do not depend on the React preview for these new tests.
- Add focused Python repository contracts locking generated-client isolation, no unsafe id64 coercion, exact key inventory, no PWA, no direct generated SDK imports in feature components, explicit route ownership, and retained React as temporary source evidence only.
- Run `pnpm check`, lint, format check, unit tests, static build, OpenAPI drift and focused Python contracts. Run the Svelte Cypress platform suite against disposable FastAPI where feasible. Commit a coherent result to the existing branch through the wrapper.

Do not delete the React application in this tranche; #580 owns feature parity and final deletion. Do not weaken or edit historical Stage 26 receipts. Report exact tests and any unresolved runtime evidence questions honestly.
